questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Guinea-Bissau?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Guinea-Bissau article.

questions.proof: The official language is Portuguese, and the capital is Bissau.
